message.content:
Here are the material options you can choose from for a custom sculpture:

| Material   |
|------------|
| Bronze     |
| Marble     |
| Terracotta |
| Wood       |
| Stone      |

Let me know which one you’d like (or if you’d like to see more details on each), and I’ll help you place the order!
